Mechatronics moved from エネルギーソリューション to 情報・光応用検査機器 (電力機器 unaffected).
日本リライアンス (80%) and its subsidiary RAS sold; deconsolidated from Q3 FY2017 (エネルギーソリューション segment).
Accounting change (not a restatement): 収益認識会計基準 adopted; 有償支給 transactions now net → FY2021 consolidated sales −1,228m vs old method; prior year not restated.
エネルギーソリューション renamed ＧＸソリューション and absorbed 情報機器 (from Q2 FY2022); 電力機器 unaffected (FY2021 電力機器 57,664 printed unchanged).

profile.products: 電力機器事業: 受変電・配電用機器 and 監視制御システム・制御機器 (manufacture, sale, installation) — extra-high-voltage 受変電設備 plants built around large transformers and gas-insulated switchgear (GIS), disconnectors (断路器), distribution equipment; mainly for TEPCO Power Grid and other Japanese utilities plus industrial/social-infrastructure plant customers. Other segments: 計量 (smart meters, instrument transformers), GX solutions (EV quick chargers "SERA"), optical inspection (3D semiconductor inspection). Seasonal: power-equipment sales concentrate in Q4 (Jan–Mar).

plants.products: 電力機器事業本部 / 電力プラント事業本部 — substation equipment incl. large transformers & GIS; new building planned under Oyama restructuring
電力機器・計量・GX — distribution equipment, meters; smart-meter assembly center (SMAC)

plants.products: polymer-applied electrical products/parts (電力機器 segment subsidiary)

power-network monitoring & control systems (電力機器 segment)

profile.end_markets: Japanese electric utilities (TEPCO Power Grid group — Takaoka Toko is a TEPCO affiliate) for substations and distribution; industrial and social-infrastructure 特別高圧受変電 plants; small overseas (SE Asia).
